# NEW 2026-11-18 round 6, shared main-line lock; 2026-11-19 round 7 F1, the main-line scheduler. Generated by gen_mainline_lock.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. No main-line event has taken this calendar month yet.
oe_ml_free = {
    OR = {
        NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ml_month }
        global_var:oe_ml_month < oe_ml_month_now
    }
}
# Any scope. The line given as the parameter line (an id of the scheduler) took this calendar month.
oe_ml_taken_by = {
    oe_ml_free = no
    has_global_variable = oe_ml_by
    global_var:oe_ml_by = $line$
}
# Any scope. This game began at the 1337 start (decision 232 item 2). The mod's lines are written for that start only;

# mark existed counts as a 1337 game.
oe_start_is_1337 = {
    has_global_variable = oe_start_1337
    global_var:oe_start_1337 = 1
}
